content.text:
**What I'd tell my friend:** The page gave me a list, not an answer. For my 30,000 ₪, the two cards that clicked were "חשבון ניירות ערך" and the "מדד S&P 500" card. The S&P card says "הכסף מושקע בדולרים דרך קרן שעוקבת אחריו", so that's the thing everyone at work talks about. For money I might need soon, there's "קרן כספית", which the page itself points to under "מאיפה להתחיל" ("כסף שצריך להישאר זמין"). I already have a קרן השתלמות through work, so that's covered. I'm fairly sure about the general direction, but I still don't know where to open the account, how much it costs or what to do first. Not one number or shekel figure on the whole page.

**How it went:**
- **Top.** "מדריך: כל סוג של חיסכון והשקעה שהאתר מכסה", which is what I came for, so I stayed.
- **"שני חלקים בכל חיסכון".** I read the first line: there's "where the money is kept" and "what it's invested in". OK, makes some sense.
- **"מאיפה להתחיל".** Three links. קרן השתלמות I already have. "קרן חדשה מקיפה" sounds like pension, not my thing today. "קרן כספית" is for money that has to stay available.
- **"איפה הכסף מוחזק".** I saw the headings: כסף שוטף וקצר, חיסכון עם הטבת מס, פרישה, לילדים, לבחירה עצמית. I skipped פרישה and לילדים. Under לבחירה עצמית I stopped on "חשבון ניירות ערך" because of "קונים, מוכרים ומחזיקים מניות".
- **"במה הכסף מושקע".** Lots of cards for different indexes. I stopped on S&P 500 because I know the name. I didn't read the cards for the Tel Aviv, Nasdaq or MSCI indexes properly.
- **Bottom.** Footer and small print, didn't read.

**Words I didn't get:** מק"מ, אג"ח, "קרן נאמנות", "חשיפה לדולר או מנוטרלת ממנו", MSCI AC World, "קרן חדשה כללית", "תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים", "קופת גמל להשקעה". There were also two little buttons, "יומית" and "מתחדשת", on the קרן כספית card, and I have no idea what they're for.

**What bothered me:**
- More than 20 cards that all look alike. On the bus I'd get tired around the index cards and just go with S&P because it's the name I know.
- Nothing on fees, nothing in shekels, no "for your amount, do this". I still don't know my first step.
- "מסלול כללי" is among the index cards, and it isn't clear how it differs from them.
- The S&P card is in the far-left column, which is where I usually stop looking. I only caught it because I knew the name.
